newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan money rates down on surplus liquidity.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan money rates down on surplus liquidity.

text.p: Pakistan's money market rates slipped lower on Sunday amid surplus funds and may hover around lower levels in the near term, dealers said.
Early overnight trades were struck at seven percent, but the rates fell later and heavy amounts were exchanged in the range of five and four percent, a dealer at KASB & Co said.
Offers for one-week funds were at 13 percent but borrowers showed no interest as they were looking at single-digit funds in the near term, the dealer said.
